impact: Dynamic client registration is unauthenticated. Any network-adjacent peer can register a client with a https://claude.ai/* redirect_uri and initiate an auth flow. PKCE prevents actual token theft, but this is unintended attack surface. Fix: add initialAccessToken to mcpAuthRouter to restrict registration.
resolution: Added ZUG_REGISTER_TOKEN env var. When set, POST /register requires it as a Bearer token (RFC 7591 initial access token pattern). Uses timingSafeEqual to prevent timing attacks. Opt-in — defaults to open registration for backward compatibility. registerClient already enforces https://claude.ai/ redirect URIs as a second layer.
title: OAuth /register endpoint is open — any peer can register a claude.ai client
